## What and why

Briefly describe the change and the reason for it.

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass.
- [ ] User-visible changes are listed under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Tried in a real terminal (`bun dev`), not only in tests.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data (kept.yaml, command logs, env values).
- [ ] Workflow changes: actions pinned to full SHAs, minimal `permissions`.
